title: Recruiter's ACTUAL opinions on "Open to Work"
description:
LinkedIn’s “OpentoWork” banner brings in a lot of heated discussion. Is it actually helpful? Does it make you look desperate. You’ll see a lot of opinions online so we ran a survey to ask actual job seekers and hiring professional what they think and wanted to share the results with you. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile
